summary.whatChanges: Fixes the server's streaming response error handler so it unwraps the inner error from the `{ error, path }` object before converting it to a TRPCError. Server `onError` callbacks now receive the actual error with its real message and cause instead of an empty-message wrapper. Tests and snapshots updated accordingly.
behaviorChanges: Server `onError` for errors thrown during streamed/iterable responses now reports the original error message instead of an empty string
The TRPCError passed to `onError` now has the original thrown error as its `cause`
Output-validation failures in streaming responses surface the full Zod issue list in the logged error message
risks: Operators with log parsing or error-reporting rules keyed on the previously empty message will now see different (and longer) messages
The `path` field from the wrapped cause is still passed as `undefined` to onError, so stream error location remains unreported
